failure_policy: Stop on the first failure and preserve every contact. No retry, no scoring, no partial quality read. A failed smoke stops the cell and the arms do not open. The smoke is re-flown whole at most once under one root-diagnosed recovery re-registration; a second failure closes the cell and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run.
